name: Dynamic Neural Motion Factorization (DynMF)
definition: A representation of dynamic 3D scenes where each 3D Gaussian's motion is modeled as a linear combination of a small set of learned basis trajectories, shared across all Gaussians.
summary: DynMF renders dynamic 3D scenes by modeling Gaussian motion as linear combinations of learned MLP basis trajectories, offering smoother, more expressive deformations than fixed Fourier bases.
